units.source_text: 很快，距离送走雏人偶的日子越来越近。

en.t: Before long, the day when the hina dolls would be sent away drew closer and closer.

units.source_text: 就像我前面讲述的，我对于卖掉雏人偶这件事并没有感到特别的悲伤。

en.t: As I said before, I did not feel especially sad about selling the hina dolls.

units.source_text: 但是，随着要送走雏人偶的日子一天比一天逼近，我在不知不觉中开始感到了即将和雏人偶分别的悲伤。

en.t: But as the day to send them away came nearer day by day, I unconsciously began to feel the sadness of parting from the hina dolls.

units.source_text: 虽然我当时还是个孩子，但是我也不会任性的想要把已经说好要卖给别人的雏人偶留在家里。

en.t: Although I was still a child then, I was not so selfish as to want to keep at home the hina dolls that had already been promised for sale to someone else.

units.source_text: 我只是想在把雏人偶交出去之前，能够再看看它们——

en.t: I only wanted to look at them once more before handing the hina dolls over.

units.source_text: 黄居内的天皇、皇后，五人组的乐团，左边的樱花树，右边的橘子树，纸灯笼，屏风，莳绘道具。

en.t: The emperor and empress inside the yellow palace, the five musicians, the cherry tree on the left, the orange tree on the right, the paper lanterns, the folding screen, and the maki-e furnishings.

units.source_text: 我想把它们摆在仓库里，再看一次。

en.t: I wanted to set them out in the storehouse and look at them one more time.

units.source_text: 但是不管我怎么恳请，性格固执的父亲死活都不答应。

en.t: But no matter how earnestly I begged, my stubborn father absolutely refused.

units.source_text: “只要手下定金，不管摆在哪里，那都是别人家的东西了。”

en.t: Once we have accepted the deposit, no matter where they are displayed, they belong to someone else.
That was what my father said.
